invitation.title: An ordinary invitation
invitation.text: {person} suggests taking a walk together. There is no crisis to solve, just a chance to spend some time.

choices.label: Make time for the walk
choices.result: I made time for an ordinary walk with {person}.

choices.label: Let this invitation pass
choices.result: I let the invitation from {person} pass without making a promise.

later.title: An ordinary memory
later.text: {person} remembers the walk and asks whether you would like to make time again.

choices.label: Make another small plan
choices.result: I made another small plan with {person}. Ordinary time together mattered.

choices.label: Leave it as a good memory
choices.result: I left the walk with {person} as a good memory without promising a routine.
